create.doc: Create a secure share token for a file or folder. v2: email is optional (omit for a public link). Sends an invitation email only when exactly one named recipient email is provided.

nid.doc: Node ID of the file or folder to share

permission_level.doc: Access level granted to recipients: can_view, can_download, can_chat, can_edit

allowed_emails.doc: Optional list of allowed emails or @domain patterns. Omit for a public (no email gate) share.

days.doc: Expiry in days, combined with hours. 0 means no expiry.

hours.doc: Expiry in hours, combined with days. 0 means no expiry.

password.doc: Optional password. Stored as salted PBKDF2-SHA512 hash — never in plain text.

access_list.doc: List all secure share tokens for a node including v2 fields (permission_level, allowed_emails). Same data as list, used by the v2 share panel.

nid.doc: Node ID to list secure share tokens for

list.doc: List all secure share tokens created by the current user for a given node, including status (active / expired / revoked) and access counts.

nid.doc: Node ID to list secure share tokens for

revoke.doc: Revoke a secure share token (soft delete — sets revoked_at timestamp). Broadcasts a secure_share_revoked event via Redis to all hub socket connections so the recipient loses access instantly.

delete.doc: Hard-delete a secure share token. Only succeeds when the token is already revoked or expired — active tokens are rejected.

token.doc: Token to permanently delete. Must already be revoked or expired.
